test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

Sumit has decided to brought his car for the picnic
solution: The correct answer is **'to brought'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • We know that after '**to**' **infinitive** the base form of the verb is used. • *Example: David is not able** to provide** an answer.* • In the given sentence '**bring**' should be used in place of '**brought**'. **Correct Sentence:__** *Sumit has decided **to bring** his car for the picnic.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • हम जानते हैं कि** 'to' infinitive** के बाद **verb** के **base from** का प्रयोग किया जाता है। • ​*Example: David is not able to provide an answer.* • दिए गए वाक्य में '**brought**' को '**bring**' में बदलना चाहिए। 3e:T94d, The erroneous spelling is** 'Fabulus'.**
